name.ja: アルトゥル・ショーペンハウアー

overview.en: Arthur Schopenhauer was a German philosopher best known for his work The World as Will and Representation, which characterized the phenomenal world as driven by a blind, purposeless will.

early_life.en: Schopenhauer was born in Danzig to a wealthy merchant family. He studied philosophy at the University of Berlin, where he developed a rivalry with Hegel.

impact.en: Schopenhauer's pessimistic philosophy and his emphasis on the will influenced Nietzsche, Freud, Wagner, Wittgenstein, and existentialism. He was also one of the first Western philosophers to engage seriously with Eastern thought.

event.en: Published The World as Will and Representation
Published On the Will in Nature
Published Parerga and Paralipomena, bringing fame

title.en: The World as Will and Representation

description.en: Major work arguing the world is driven by an irrational, purposeless will

text.en: All truth passes through three stages: first it is ridiculed, second it is violently opposed, third it is accepted as self-evident.
